query: INSERT INTO guild_recording_policy (guild_id,excluded_channel_ids,updated_by,notice_delivery) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,COALESCE($4,'dm')) ON CONFLICT (guild_id) DO UPDATE SET excluded_channel_ids=EXCLUDED.excluded_channel_ids,updated_by=EXCLUDED.updated_by,notice_delivery=COALESCE($4,guild_recording_policy.notice_delivery),updated_at=now() RETURNING notice_delivery
